description: Make a 3D model game-ready (needs, in the game folder: npm i -D @gltf-transform/core @gltf-transform/extensions @gltf-transform/functions meshoptimizer sharp). mode "prop": dedup, prune, WebP textures (tex, default 512), Meshopt; tris or simplify cut triangles. mode "char": a rigged character, with clips (comma list of other GLBs of the same rig, merged by bone name, Name=file.glb to name one), textures 1024, Meshopt without position quantisation (it breaks skinned meshes). fix_winding flips inside-out meshes (dark in game) and smooths normals. Writes <name>.packed.glb unless out is given; prints sizes and how to load it.

dir.description: The game folder (default: the folder the assistant runs in).

name: growblocks_pack
title: Pack a 3D model
